description:
**Why Socure?**
Socure is building the identity trust infrastructure for the digital economy — verifying 100% of good identities in real time and stopping fraud before it starts. The mission is big, the problems are complex, and the impact is felt by businesses, governments, and millions of people every day.
  
  
We hire people who want that level of responsibility. People who move fast, think critically, act like owners, and care deeply about solving customer problems with precision. * Build and own backend services, REST APIs, and microservices from design through production.
* Develop scalable, secure, and maintainable application-layer systems.
* Work on distributed systems, asynchronous workflows, messaging, retries, and fault tolerance.
* Partner with Product, Infrastructure, Data Science/ML, and Engineering teams.
* Improve performance, reliability, observability, and engineering standards.
* Participate in technical design, code reviews, testing, CI/CD, and production troubleshooting.

* 3+ years of professional backend software engineering experience, with experience building scalable, reliable distributed systems
* Strong coding skills in Go, Java, or a similar backend language.
* Solid computer science fundamentals, including data structures, algorithms, and distributed systems.
* Experience with REST APIs, microservices, SQL/NoSQL databases, and event-driven systems.

* Strong ownership mindset and ability to take features/services end-to-end.

We value engineers who are strong in application-layer backend development, learn quickly, and enjoy solving complex problems with direct customer and business impact.

title: Engineering Lead - Grid & Devices (IoT / Energy Systems)
description:
**Hiring Entity: FlexEnergi, a Subsidiary of Accurant**
**Location: Remote**
**Salary Range: 3,700,000 - 5,500,000 INR**
**Job Title: Engineering Lead - Grid & Devices (IoT / Energy Systems)**
We are hiring an
**Engineering Lead**
to own FlexEnergi's Grid & Devices area end to end: how our DERMS platform connects to devices, which grid standards we speak, and how we dispatch flexible energy resources in real time. It's the most technically demanding part of our platform and the one our utility customers look at first.
  
  
This is a
**lead role first and a management role second**
. Expect roughly 70% hands-on technical ownership (architecture, building, code review, and running production systems) and 30% leading a small team of 2-4 engineers. It's ideal for a senior engineer who wants to be accountable for a critical area, not step away from the code.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Own the technical direction for Grid & Devices and write the technical plan the team builds from
* Own the real-time dispatch engine running in production: its design, reliability, and extension to new device types, portfolio-level dispatch, and grid-aware constraints
* Own the connector architecture and our growing library of device integrations: OEM cloud APIs, aggregator platforms, and direct-to-device protocols
* Lead our path to OpenADR, IEEE 2030.5 / CSIP, BACnet, Modbus, and OCPP/OCPI compliance and certification, including buy-vs-build decisions on protocol stacks
* Expand the platform from residential devices into commercial and industrial (C&I) equipment: building management systems, HVAC, batteries, and generators
* Write code, review code, and set the engineering standards that keep a growing integration library maintainable
* Own production health for your area (observability, failure handling, runbooks) together with our platform and DevOps engineers
* Work with product, solution architecture, and utility operations to turn customer requirements into scoped, sequenced engineering work, and push back when needed
* Lead and grow a small team of engineers: 1:1s, feedback, day-to-day prioritization, and hiring as the team grows
* Taking ownership of FlexEnergi's production dispatch engine and evolving it for new device classes
* Bringing standards-based grid protocols (OpenADR, IEEE 2030.5) into the platform
* Extending device support to batteries and commercial building systems
* Grid-aware dispatch that respects feeder and transformer constraints
* Taking ownership of FlexEnergi's production dispatch engine and evolving it for new device classes
* Bringing standards-based grid protocols (OpenADR, IEEE 2030.5) into the platform
* Extending device support to batteries and commercial building systems
* Grid-aware dispatch that respects feeder and transformer constraints

**Requirements**
**Required:**

* 8+ years of software engineering experience (backend-focused)
* Deep, hands-on experience with device integration, IoT, or real-time control systems in production: DER, EV charging, smart metering, building automation, industrial IoT, or similar
* Has owned a production system end to end: designed it, shipped it, supported it, and improved it
* Strong experience with distributed, event-driven systems: queues and streams, retries and idempotency, time-series data, and devices that are slow, flaky, or offline
* Strong experience with .NET (C#), or deep experience in Java, Go, or similar and willing to work in .NET
* Experience as a technical lead, setting direction for a team and raising the bar through design and code review
* Clear written communication and comfort working async across time zones

**Preferred:**

* Most of your career at product companies, building and running your own product rather than delivering client projects
* Hands-on experience with OpenADR (2.0b / 3.1), IEEE 2030.5 / CSIP, BACnet, Modbus, or OCPP, or with certification testing for any of them
* Experience with OEM or aggregator APIs for EVs, chargers, thermostats, or batteries
* Experience with Azure (Event Hub, Service Bus, Functions, Container Apps) and Postgres / Citus
* Understanding of grid and power-system concepts: demand response, DERMS, feeder and transformer constraints
* Early-stage or startup experience owning scope that wasn't fully defined

**About Us**
*FlexEnergi*
*is solving some of the toughest challenges facing today's utilities. With rising data center demand, more renewables, and increasing extreme weather, utilities need reliable capacity that can be deployed fast and affordably. Our innovative business model delivers the lowest-cost, fastest to-deploy capacity on the market. We're a small, nimble, and innovative company that moves quickly, experiments boldly, and rethinks how the grid can improve quickly. Joining FlexEnergi means helping build technology that strengthens reliability, resilience, and sustainability at scale. FlexEnergi proudly operates as part of the Accurant portfolio of companies.*
*Accurant*
*Family of compan*
ies
*offer innovative solutions to tackle pressing climate and energy technology challenges through our portfolio companies. Our investments include fields around energy and clean-tech ranging from renewable energy management, smart grid technologies, grid automation and management, demand response and virtual power plants, distribution system sensors and AI analytics, and professional services and expert consulting.*

****aligned, interpretable, and safe superintelligent systems****

. Our work spans alignment methodologies, interpretability-led system design, and foundational model research across structured, tabular, and enterprise data. We build AI systems intended for real-world deployment, where transparency, auditability, and robustness are first-class constraints.

****The Role****

We are building a 
****high-autonomy AI Engineering Agent****

 that can execute end-to-end AI engineering workflows on top of the Lexsi backend. The system is designed to reason over complex objectives, plan multi-step actions, interact with tools and data systems, evaluate outcomes, and iterate over long horizons while remaining interpretable and aligned.

, you will be responsible for defining and building the core agent architecture. You will make foundational decisions about how the agent reasons, plans and executes actions, maintains memory and state, and has its decisions inspected and explained. This role requires deep hands-on engineering and the ability to operate in ambiguous environments with ownership from day one.

   that can autonomously perform tasks such as experiment design, evaluation, analysis, and reporting, rather than merely assisting a human in these workflows.
